justification: Pittman's Out, that's not a projection, that's a doctor's note, so he don't eat this week — I already went to the market Tuesday for exactly this, brought in the Pittsburgh kid Roman Wilson for standard money, and he steps into WR2 because insurance you don't use is just money you burned for nothing. Everybody else stays in their chair: Javonte's still RB1 because a back who runs angry don't lose his spot to a healthy scratch, Chase Brown keeps grinding at RB2, Murray's my guy at quarterback and I don't churn a signal-caller over seven-tenths of a point on some sheet, LaPorta and Fannin hold tight end and flex because they ain't done nothing to get benched, and Bates and the Seattle D ride as-is. We're 1-3 and I know it better than the woman writing the column, but I don't panic a lineup and I don't bench family over a bad month — I just stopped carrying a man who can't suit up, and that's business, not spite.
